scope: Bound researcher invitation joining and offline-role reconnection
behavior: Both connection paths have a three-minute deadline covering local validation and guarded wallet/SDK/ledger/report verification.
Workspace lifetime checks guard installation; expired or closed results cannot create a researcher workspace or replace an offline session with a connection.
Expiry releases the existing operation lock for explicit retry. Existing offline vaults and reviewed invitation inputs remain available. No transaction submission is added.

unit.scope: Four new invitation/reconnect timeout/unmount cases plus complete RoleWorkspace and role-network regressions. New cases verify the passed continuation guard rejects closed operations.

browser.scope: Existing desktop/mobile roles and invitation journeys, including stalled wallet authorization, isolated invitation sharing, invalid-link recovery and role backup restoration.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest after browser tests.

limits: New three-minute connection cases mock joinRoleVault; existing browser cases do not perform a funded native-wallet connection or physical suspend test.
Already-started wallet/SDK work is not cancelled. The application prevents further continuation or installation.
No full regression, runtime-image refresh or public deployment.
